bugs.text: Syntax error: group objects written as slots:[3,0],[3,1],... (missing outer array) -> 'Unexpected token ,'; the whole script fails to parse, page stays black.
Game can never start: update() returns for the title state before updateFlow(), so pressed('Enter') is never checked (prevKeys also never updated in title).
Enemies never enter: no code sets state='enter'; spawned enemies stay in 'wait' forever off-screen, so no formation, no dives and the stage can never be cleared.
Player never appears at game start: startGame sets active=false and respawn=0, and resetPlayer is only called when respawn counts down to 0.
Challenging stage soft-locks once any challenger is shot: killEnemy never decrements G.waveAlive, so the wave never ends.
Rescued/hostile captive disappears with its boss because it is stored on the removed boss; dual fighter can never form.
Challenging stage hits/wave bonuses/PERFECT never counted (totalHits/waveHits never incremented); hits score normal values, not 100.
readyTimer only counts down in 'play', so READY stays on screen for the whole challenging stage.
No stage badge shown on stage 1 (flags computed from stage-1).

summary: The file is a compact, readably structured Galaga attempt (sprite data, bezier path helper, fixed-timestep loop, beam/capture state machine, synthesized sounds) that never runs: a malformed object literal at lines 218-227 is a parse error, so the page is black from load to the end of the play test. Even with that fixed it would still not be playable: Enter is never processed on the title screen, the player is never activated at game start, and enemies are never switched into their entry flight, so no formation or dives could happen. Beyond those blockers, the rescue/dual-fighter path loses the captive when the boss is removed, and challenging stages soft-lock after any hit and never count hits or bonuses. The design shows good knowledge of Galaga, but as delivered it is not playable.
